title: The World According to LLMs: How Geographic Origin Influences LLMs’ Entity Deduction Capabilities

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs as guessers in a multi-turn 20 Questions game to deduce entities from the Geo20Q+ dataset, comparing success rates and the number of turns required for entities originating from different continents and economic regions (Global North vs. Global South).

Analyzing performance disparities in deducing culturally significant objects (e.g., foods, landmarks) and notable people across cultural lines, specifically comparing deduction success rates between the Global West and Global East.
